stem.text: A ball is thrown horizontally off a tall building. The ground is horizontal. Air resistance is negligible.
Which statement about the motion of the ball is correct?

A.text: The acceleration of the ball is always at right angles to the path of the ball.

B.text: The ball follows a circular path until it hits the ground.

D.text: The ball’s time in the air is proportional to the velocity at which the ball is thrown.
